title: Real-Time Execution of Action Chunking Flow Policies
authors: Kevin Black, Manuel Y. Galliker, Sergey Levine

tldr.en: Generate the next chunk while executing the current one; freeze committed actions and inpaint the remainder without policy retraining.
tldr.zh: 在执行当前动作块时生成下一块，冻结已承诺执行的动作并补全其余部分，无需重训策略。

evaluation_scope.en: Twelve dynamic Kinetix tasks and six bimanual real tasks. Targets delay robustness and throughput; guidance is not a claim of fewer base-model evaluations.
evaluation_scope.zh: 12 项动态 Kinetix 任务与 6 项双臂真机任务。目标是延迟鲁棒性与吞吐；引导补全并不代表减少基座前向次数。
